Source: Patients with hypoxia (oxygen saturation <90%), hypotension (systolic blood pressure <90mmHg) and reduced conscious level (Glasgow Coma Scale <9) were included in the study.
Luganda: Abalwadde abalina omukka ogussibwa omutono (omukka ogussibwa <90%), puleesa eya wansi (puleesa y’omusaayi <90mmHg) n’okutegeera okutono (Olugerero lwa kkoma olwa Glasgow <9) be baayingizibwa mu kunoonyereza kuno.
Yoruba: Wọ́n aláìsàn tí wọ́n ní àìtó èèmí (ìrìnyíká àfẹ́fẹ́-èèmí <90%), ẹ̀jẹ̀ lílẹ (ìsọkúlú-ọkàn fún ìfúnpá <90mmHg) àti ìpele ìtakìjí tí ó rọlẹ̀ (Àyẹ̀wò Afòtémẹ́ta Ṣègbéléwọ̀n <9) sí ìwádìí náà.
Zulu: Iziguli ezinempelamoya (ubuningi be-oksijini <90%), ihaphontesheni (ukuhamba kwegazi ngokushaya kwenhliziyo <90mmHg) kanye nezinga elincishisiwe lokuphaphama (isikalo iGlasgo Coma <9) kufakwe ocwaningweni.

Northern Sotho: Balwetši ba haephošiya (go retela ga oksitšene <90%), haephothenšene (kgatelelo ya pitlelego ya madi <90mmHg) le go idibala (Sekala sa Kidibalo sa Glasgow <9) ba akareditšwe go dinyakišišo.
Amharic: ሃይፖክሲያ ያለባቸው ታካሚዎች (የኦክስጅን ሙሌት <90%)፣ የደም ግፊት መቀነስ (ሲስቶሊክ የደም ግፊት <90mmHg) እና ዝቅተኛ የንቃት ደረጃ (ግላስጎው ኮማ ስኬል <9) በጥናቱ ውስጥ ተካተዋል

Source: The a-priori defined essential treatments were oxygen therapy for hypoxia, intravenous fluid for hypotension and an action to protect the airway for reduced consciousness (placing the patient in the lateral position, insertion of an oro-pharyngeal airway or endo-tracheal tube or manual airway protection).
Luganda: Obujjanjabi obwetaagisa bwali okuweebwa omukka ogussibwa eri abo abalina omutono, okussibwamu eddagala ly’omu misuwa eri abo aba puleesa eya wansi n’okubaako ekikolebwa okukuuma ekkubo ly’empewo eri abo abakendedde mu kutegeera (okugalamiza omulwadde wansi, okuteeka olupiira lw’empewo mu mumiro oba okukuuma ekkubo ly’omukka mu ngeri endala).
Yoruba: Àwọn ìtọ́jú tó ṣe kókó tí wọ́n ti là kalẹ̀ látẹ̀yìnwá ni afẹ́ẹ́-èèmí fún ìtọ́jú àìlera àìtó èèmí, omi afúnilókun fún ẹ̀jẹ̀ lílẹ àti ìsọjí láti dáàbò bo ọ̀nà-èèmí fún ìtakìjí tí ó rọlẹ̀ (jíjẹ́ kí aláìsàn nà gbọọrọ, ṣíṣàfikún ọ̀nà-èémí kélé ọ̀nà ọ̀fun tàbí túùbù orí kòmóòkun/tán-án-ná tàbí ìfọwọ́dáàbò bo ọ̀nà èèmí).
Zulu: Izindlela zokwelapha ezibalulekile ezichazwe ngokwencwadi kwakuwukwelapha kwe-oksijini kwempelamoya, uketshezi olungena emthanjeni lwe-haphontesheni kanye nesenzo sokuvikela indlela yomoya ukuze ukwazi ukuqaphela okunciphile (ukubeka isiguli endaweni engemuva, ukufakwa kwendlela yomoya yomphimbo noma ishubhu lamankanka noma ukuvikelwa kwendlela yomoya imanuwali).
Hausa: Magungunan jiyya da aka ayyana a rubuce su ne maganin iskar shaƙa don cutar rashin isasshen numfashi, ƙarin ruwa domin hauhawar jini da kuma wani aiki don kare hanyar iska don rage hayyaci (sanya mara lafiya a matsayi na gefe, shigar da hanyar iska ta oro-pharyngeal ko bututun endo-tracheal ko kariyar hanyar iska ta hannu).
Northern Sotho: Dikalafo tše bohlokwa tše di hlalošwago ka teori e bile kalafi ya oksitšene ya haephošiya, seela se se hlabelwago tšhikeng sa haephothenšene le kgato ya go šireletša tsela ya moya go phafogo ye e fokotšegilego (go robatša molwetši ka lehlakore, go tsenywa ga tselamoya ka molomo go ya lešobeng la mogolo goba tšhupu ya ka gare ga kgokgokgo goba tšhireletšo ya tselamoya ya tlwaelo).

Yoruba: Wọ́n fẹ́ wò ó bóyá àwọn aláìsàn tí wọ́n ní ìṣòro láti mí gbà afẹ́fẹ́ ìmí (afẹ́fẹ́ èèmí), bí àwọn tí ìfunpá wọn rọlẹ̀ bá gba ‘omi’ tàbí bọ́yá wọ́n tẹ́ àwọn tí wọ́n dákú sílẹ̀ dáadáa.
Zulu: Babefuna ukubona ukuthi iziguli ebezinenkinga yokuphefumula ziyawuthola yini umoya wokuphefumula (oksijini), uma lezo ezinomfutho wegazi ophansi zithola ‘amadiliphu oketshezi, noma eziqulekile zilaliswe kahle yini.
Hausa: Suna son su ga ko marasa lafiya da suke fama da wahalar numfashi sun sami iskar iska (iskar shaƙa), idan waɗanda suke da ƙarancin hauhawar jini sun sami ‘ƙarin ruwa’, ko kuma waɗanda ba sa cikin hayyacinsu an kwantar da su yadda ya kamata.
Northern Sotho: Ba be ba nyaka go bona ge e ba balwetši bao ba bego ba na le bothata bja go hema ba filwe moya wa hema (oksitšene), ge e ba bao ba bego ba na le kgatelelo ya fase ya madi ba filwe ‘sehlare ka ditiripi’, goba ge e ba bao ba bego ba idibetše ba robadišitšwe ka tshwanelo.
Amharic: የመተንፈስ ችግር ያለባቸው ታካሚዎች የአተነፋፈስ አየር (ኦክስጅን) መቀበላቸውን፣ ዝቅተኛ የደም ግፊት ያለባቸው ሰዎች ‘ፈሳሽ ጠብታዎች’ መቀበላቸውን፣ ወይም ራሳቸውን የሳቱ ሰዎች በትክክል እንደተቀመጡ ለማየት ፈልገው ነበር።

Source: The researchers found out that of the 1135 patients they checked, 4.0% had difficulty breathing, 9.1% had low blood pressure, and 1.5% were unconscious.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baakizuula nti ku balwadde 1135 be baakebera, ebitundu 4.0% baalina obuzibu mu kussa, 9.1% baalina puleesa eya wansi, so nga 1.5% baali tebakyategeera bulungi.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwahdìí náà rí i pé láàrin àwọn aláìsàn 1135 tí wọ́n yẹ̀ wò, 4.0% ní wọ́n ní ìṣòro ìmísókè-mísódò, 9.1% ni ìfúnpá wọn rọlẹ̀, 1.5% sì dákú.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bathole ukuthi ezigulini eziyi-1135 abazihlolile, ama-4.0% unokuphefumula kanzima, ama-9.1% anomfutho wegazi ophansi, ama-1.5% uqulekile.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun gano cewa daga cikin marasa lafiya guda 1135 da suka duba, kashi 4.0% suna da wahalar numfashi, kashi 9.1% suna da hauhawar jini, kuma kashi 1.5% ba a hayyacinsu suke ba.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba hweditše gore go balwetši ba 1135 bao ba ba lekotšego, ba 4.0% ba bile le bothata bja go hema, ba 9.1% ba bile le kgatelelo ya fase ya madi, le ba 1.5% ba be ba idibetše.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ ምርመራ ካደረጉላቸው 1135 ታካሚዎች ውስጥ፣ 4.0% ያህሉ የመተንፈስ ችግር፣ 9.1% ዝቅተኛ የደም ግፊት፣ እና 1.5% የሚሆኑት እራሳቸውን የሳቱ መሆናቸውን አረጋግጠዋል።

Source: They said 88.9% of those who had difficulty in breathing did not get breathing air (oxygen), 91.3% of those with low blood pressure did not get drips, and 53% of those who were not unconscious were not laid down properly to help them breathe.
Luganda: Baagamba nti ebitundu 88.9% eby’abo abaalina obuzibu mu kussa tebaafuna mukka gussibwa, 91.3% aby’abo abaalina puleesa eya wansi tebassibwako macupa, so nga 53% eby’abo abaali tebakyategeera bulungi tebaagalamizibwa wansi bulungi okubayamba okussa.
Yoruba: Wọ́n ní 88.9% àwọn tí wọ́n ní ìsòro ìmísókè-mísódò kò rí afẹ́fẹ́ láti fi mí (afẹ́fẹ́-èèmí), 91.3% àwọn tí wọ́n ìfúnpa wọn rọlè kò rí omi gbà, àti pé 53% àwọn tí kò dákú ni wọn kò tẹ́ sílẹ̀ lọ́nà tó tọ́ láti ràn mímí wọn lọ́wọ́.
Zulu: Bathe ama-88.9% wabanenkinga yokuphefumula awawutholi umoya wokuphefumula (oksijini), ama-91.3% wabanomfutho wegazi ophansi awuwatholanga amadiliphu, ama-53% walabo abebengaqulekile awazange abekwe phansi ukuze asizwe baphefumule.
Hausa: Sun ce kashi 88.9% na waɗanda suke fama da wahalar numfashi ba sa samun iska (iskar shaƙa), kashi 91.3% na masu fama da hauhawar jini ba sa samun ƙarin ruwa, sannan kashi 53% na waɗanda ba sa hayyacinsu ba a kwantar da su yadda ya kamata don taimaka musu yin numfashi ba.
Northern Sotho: Ba boletše gore 88.9% tša balwetši bao ba bilego le bothata bja go hema ga se ba fiwa moya wa hema (oksitšene), 91.3% tša bao ba bilego le kgatelelo ya fase ya madi ga se ba hwetša ditiripi, le 53% tša bao ba bego ba idibetše ga se ba robatšwa ka tshwanelo go ba thuša go hema.
Amharic: የመተንፈስ ችግር ካለባቸው ውስጥ 88.9% የሚሆኑት የትንፋሽ አየር (ኦክስጅን) አላገኙም፣ 91.3% ዝቅተኛ የደም ግፊት ካለባቸው ውስጥ ጠብታዎች አላገኙም፣ እና 53% የሚሆኑት እራሳቸውን የሳቱ ሰዎች እንዲተነፍሱ ለመርዳት በትክክል ጋደም ተደርገው አልተቀመጡም ብለዋል።

Source: The researchers also reported that 22% of those who had difficulty breathing, 22% of those with low blood pressure, and 53% of those who were unconscious died within a week while in hospital.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza era baagamba nti ebitundu 22% eby’abo abaalina obuzibu mu kussa, 22% eby’abo abaalina puleesa eya wansi, ne 53% eby’abo abaali tebakyategeera bulungi baafa mu wiiki emu nga bali mu ddwaliro.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí náà tún jábọ̀ pé 22% àwọn tí wọ́n ní ìsọro ìmísókè-mísódò, 22% àwọn tí ìfúnpá wọn rọlẹ̀, àti 53% àwọn tí wọ́n dákú ni wọ́n kú láàrin ọ̀sẹ̀ kan tí wọ́n dé sí ilé-ìwòsàn.
Zulu: Abacwaningi baphinde babika ukuthi ama-22% wababenenkinga yokuphefumula, ama 22% wabanomfutho wegazi ophansi, nama-53% wababequlekile bashone lingakapheli isonto besesibhedlela.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun kuma bayar da rahoton cewa kashi 22% na waɗanda suke fama da wahalar numfashi, da kashi 22% na masu fama da hauhawar jini, da kuma kashi 53% na waɗanda ba sa cikin hayyacinsu sun mutu a cikin mako guda yayin da suke asibiti.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba begile le gore 22% tša bao ba bilego le bothata bja go hema, 22% tša bao ba bilego le kgatelelo ya fase ya madi, le 53% tša bao ba ilego ba idibala ba hlokofetše pele beke e fela ge ba le sepetlele.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ በተጨማሪም የመተንፈስ ችግር ካለባቸው 22%፣ ዝቅተኛ የደም ግፊት ከሆኑት 22%፣ እና እራሳቸውን ከሳቱት ውስጥ 53% በአንድ ሳምንት ጊዜ ውስጥ በሆስፒታል ውስጥ ህይወታቸው ማለፉን ተናግረዋል።

Source: These results suggest that more must be done in these hospitals to provide relevant treatment to critically ill patients with Covid-19 or other diseases, as many lives could be saved without the need for expensive hospital equipment.
Luganda: Ebyazuulibwa bino biraga nti wateekwa okubaawo ebirala ebikolebwa mu malwaliro gano okutuusa obujjanjabi eri abalwadde abayi abalina Covid-19 oba endwadde endala, kubanga abantu bangi abasobola okutaasibwa awatali kwetaaga byuma bya malwaliro eby’ebbeeyi.
Yoruba: Àbọ̀ ìwádìí náà dábàá pé iṣẹ́ ṣì kù ní ṣíṣe ní àwọn ilé-ìwòsàn náà láti pèsè ìtọ́jú tí ó yẹ fún àwọn aláìsàn bẹ́mìídíje tí wọ́n ní Covid-19 tàbí àwọn àìsàn mìíràn, bí ó ṣe jẹ́ pé wọhn lè dóòlà ọ̀pọ̀ ẹ̀mí láìnílò àwọn ohun-èlò olówó iyebíye ní ilé-ìwòsàn.
Zulu: Le miphumela iphakamisa ukuthi kuningi okufanele kwenziwe kulezi zibhedlela ukuze kuhlinzekwe ukwelashwa okufanele ezigulini ezigula kakhulu ezine-Covid-19 noma ezinye izifo, njengoba izimpilo eziningi zingasindiswa ngaphandle kwesidingo semishini yasesibhedlela ebizayo.
Hausa: Waɗannan sakamakon sun bayar da shawarar cewa dole ne a ƙara yin aiki a waɗannan asibitocin don bayar da kulawar da ta dace ga masu matsananciyar rashin lafiya masu fama da cutar ta Covid-19 ko wasu cututtuka, saboda ana iya ceton rayuka da yawa ba tare da buƙatar kayan aikin asibiti masu tsada ba.
Northern Sotho: Dipoelo tše di šišinya gore go swanetše go dirwa go tlala seatla ka dipetleleng tše go fana ka kalafo ya maleba go balwetši bao ba lwago kudu ka Covid-19 goba malwetši a mangwe, ka ge maphelo a mantši a ka bolokwa go sa šomišwe ditlabela tše di bitšago tšhelete ye ntši tša sepetlele.
Amharic: እነዚህ ውጤቶች የኮቪድ-19 ወይም ሌላ በሽታ ላለባቸው ለጽኑ ሕመምተኞች ተገቢውን ሕክምና ለመስጠት በእነዚህ ሆስፒታሎች ውስጥ የበለጠ ነገር መደረግ እንዳለበት ይጠቁማሉ፣ ውድ የሆኑ የሆስፒታል መሳሪያዎች ሳያስፈልጉ የብዙ ሰዎችን ህይወት ማዳን ይቻል ነበር።

Source: The researchers however cautioned against drawing broader conclusions based on their study, since they only looked at patients from 2 hospitals and only collected data for 5 days.
Luganda: Wabula abanoonyereza baalabula ku ky’obutakola kukubira ttwalirawamu okusinziira ku kunoonyereza kuno, olw’okuba nga baatunuulira balwadde bokka okuva mu malwaliro 2 era nga bye beekenneenya baabikuŋŋaanyiza mu nnaku 5 zokka.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣewádìí náà sì tún pè fún ìkoraẹni ní ìjánu nípa ṣíṣe ìpinnu tó fẹjú jù fún látara ìwádìí wọn, níwọ̀n ìgbà tí ó jẹ́ pé ilé-ìwòsàn 2 ni wọ́n ti wo àwọn aláìsàn, tí ó sì jé pé ọjọ́ 5 péré ni wọ́n fi gba dátà.
Zulu: Abacwaningi nokho baxwayise ngokuthatha iziphetho ezibanzi ngokusekelwe ocwaningweni lwabo, njengoba babheka iziguli ezivela ezibhedlela ezi-2 kuphela futhi baqoqa ingcobelelo yezinsuku ezi-5 kuphela.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun yi taka tsantsan game da yanke shawara gama-gari dangane da bincikensu, tunda sun kalli marasa lafiya ne kawai daga asibitoci 2 kuma sun tattara bayanai ne kawai na kwanaki 5.
Northern Sotho: Le ge go le bjalo, banyakišiši ba lemošitše gore go se fihlelelwe diphetho tša kakaretšo go lebeletšwe dinyakišišo tša bona, ka ge dinyakišišo di be di lebeletše fela balwetši go tšwa dipetleleng tše 2 le datha ye e kgobokeditšwego matšatši a 5 fela.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ ግን ከ2 ሆስፒታሎች ታካሚዎችን ብቻ በመመልከት ለ 5 ቀናት ያህል መረጃን ስለሰበሰቡ፣ በጥናታቸው ሰፋ ያለ መደምደሚያ እንዳይሰጥ አስጠንቅቀዋል።

Source: They also said the treatments they looked for in this study do not always save the lives of patients, so they may have overestimated the need for such treatments.
Luganda: Era baagamba nti obujjanjabi bwe baali banoonya mu kunoonyereza kuno tebutaasa bulamu bwa balwadde ekiseera kyonna, noolwekyo bayinza okuba nga baasukkulumya nnyo obwetaavu bw’obujjanjabi obw’engeri eno.
Yoruba: Wọ́n tún sọ pé àwọn ìtọ́jú tí àwọn wá nínú ìwádìí yìí kì í dóólà ẹ̀mí àwọn aláìsàn ní gbogbo ìgbà, fú ìdí èyí wọ́n ti lè dojú kọ ìlò àwọn ìtọ́jú náà ju bó se yẹ lọ.
Zulu: Baphinde bathi imishanguzo abebeyibhekile kulolu cwaningo ayigcini nje ngokusindisa impilo yeziguli, ngakho-ke kungenzeka ukuthi basilinganisela ngokweqile isidingo sokwelashwa okunjalo.
Hausa: Sun kuma ce magungunan da suka kalla a cikin wannan binciken ba koyaushe suke ceton rayukan marasa lafiya ba, don haka, wataƙila sun wuce gona da iri na buƙatar irin waɗannan magunguna.
Northern Sotho: Ba boletše le gore dikalafo tše ba bego ba di lebeletše ka dinyakišišong tše ga se ka mehla di bolokago maphelo a balwetši, ka gona ba ka ba ba gateletše go fetišiša nyakego ya dikalafo tšeo.
Amharic: በተጨማሪም በዚህ ጥናት ውስጥ የታዩት ህክምናዎች የታካሚዎችን ህይወት ሁልጊዜ የሚያድኑ አይደሉም፣ ስለዚህ የእንደዚህ ዓይነቱን ህክምና አስፈላጊነት ከመጠን በላይ ገምተው ሊሆን ይችላል።

Source: The researchers recommended more studies to understand why critical patients often do not get essential treatments, and how hospitals might use more of these cost-effective measures to save lives.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baateesa nti wabeewo okunoonyereza okulala okutegeera lwaki abalwadde abayi tebatera kufuna bujjanjabi obwetaagisa, n’engeri amalwaliro gye gayinza okweyambisaamu enkola zino ezitali za buseere okutaasa obulamu.
Yoruba: Aṣèwádìí náà dábàá ìwádìí síwájú sí i láti lóye ìdí tí àwọn aláìsàn bẹ́mìídíje kì í ṣe é sáábà rí àwọn ìtọ́jú tó ṣe kókó, àti bí àwọn ilé-ìwòsàn ṣe túnbọ̀ lè lo irú àwọn ọ̀nà tí ò gani lára bẹ́ẹ̀ láti dóòlà ẹ̀mí.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bancome ucwaningo olwengeziwe ukuze baqonde ukuthi kungani iziguli ezibucayi ngokuvamile zingakutholi ukwelashwa okubalulekile, nokuthi izibhedlela zingasebenzisa kanjani lezi zinyathelo ezingabizi kakhulu ukuze zisindise izimpilo.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun bayar da shawarar ƙarin bincike don fahimtar dalilin da yasa marasa lafiya galibi ba sa samun mahimman jiyya, da kuma yadda asibitoci za su yi amfani da ƙarin waɗannan matakan marasa tsada don ceton rayuka.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba šišintše gore go dirwe dinyakišišo tše dingwe go kwešiša mabaka ao a bakago gore balwetši ba malwetši a šoro ba sa hwetše dikalafo tše bohlokwa, le ka moo dipetlele di ka šomišago bontši bja magato ao a go boloka tšhelete go boloka maphelo.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ ጽኑ ህመምተኞች ለምን አስፈላጊ ህክምና እንደማይሰጣቸው፣ እና ሆስፒታሎች ህይወትን ለማዳን ብዙ ወጪ-ቆጣቢ እርምጃዎችን እንዴት እንደሚጠቀሙ ለመረዳት ተጨማሪ ጥናቶችን መክረዋል።
